Colonel Blotto game In a Colonel Blotto game, two players, A and B, have N and M soldiers, respectively, which they must allocate across K battlefields. In each round t, player A selects an allocation of N soldiers, denoted as at = (at,1 , . . . , at,K ), where at,i ≥ 0 represents the number of soldiers assigned to battlefield i, and the total allocation satisfies K P i=1 at,i = N . Simultaneously, player B chooses an allocation of M soldiers, given by bt = (bt,1 , . . . , bt,K ). At each battlefield i, player A incurs a loss of yt,i [at,i , bt,i ].
